changes.title: Every board page opens on the same deep red as the home page
changes.why: The home page is oxblood and the shop pages are plain white, so it feels like two different sites; a site should look like one (website rule 3k, consistency).

changes.title: A green "Save $77" tag on the two Large boards
changes.why: The saving is real (size for size against the Medium) but was only on the home page, in a sentence; shops show it as a short tag where you choose (rules 3j and 3s).

changes.title: Each basket line gets a photo and a remove button
changes.why: There was no way to take a board out of the order except pressing minus; every basket line needs a bin button and the picture appears with the name (rule 3k and 3s).

changes.title: Step 1 fits one screen; no stray "Add another board" button
changes.why: The board choice ran to 1,447 px tall with wine listed before any board was chosen, and an "Add another board" button showed on an empty order; now one slim line per board, wine only after a board (rules 3c.12, 3j.2).

changes.title: On a phone, the wine Add buttons stay inside their boxes
changes.why: On a phone the Add button poked out past the edge of the box and cut the names in two; one wine per row fixes it (checklist: consistency, nothing cut off).

changes.title: Home price list: real "Order this board" buttons and a "Save" tag
changes.why: The order link was tiny 11 px text and the saving a long sentence; a pressable thing should look pressable, and badges are two or three words (rules 3s.1 and the prices rule).

changes.title: Step 2 offers the next four available days as one tap
changes.why: A plain date box asks the visitor to work out the earliest day themselves, and an empty Time box showed before any day was chosen; fewer choices first, each showing its consequence (rule 3s.16 and 3s.17).

questions: The home page lists The All Jerky Board at $149 but your order system has it at $139. Which price is right?
Does a board ever come with a choice (for example which meats or gluten-free), so we can say it on each board? We would then show it before the board is added.
Do you have a photo of a board at a party or being delivered, and one of you making the boards? We would add them after the opening.
Is there a guarantee or promise you want beside the order button, for example a remake if something is wrong?
The Party Board has no size on the site. What is its size in centimetres, so it can be drawn to scale like the others?
checks_now: check-site: tiny tap targets and the opening words hidden with motion off on the home page; Add and filter buttons with no hover or press state, and the filter jumping the page by up to 1,579 px on the boards page; check-fits: boards page and order steps taller than the screen (up to 2,125 px); check-motion: the filter switches with a jump; the order pages crash check-site's own tap test (checker limit).
